from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Boolean, DateTime, BigInteger, ForeignKey, Numeric
from sqlalchemy.orm import relationship
from sqlalchemy.ext.declarative import declarative_base

Base = declarative_base()


class Estacao(Base):
    __tablename__ = "estacao"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    codigo = Column(String(20), nullable=False, unique=True)
    nome = Column(String(80), nullable=False)
    ativo = Column(Boolean)
    criado = Column(DateTime)


class Municipio(Base):
    __tablename__ = "municipio"

    uf = Column(String(2))
    cod = Column(Integer)
    nome = Column(String(60))
    # chave composta: uf, cod (use PrimaryKeyConstraint em __table_args__)


class Medicao(Base):
    __tablename__ = "medicao"

    id = Column(BigInteger, primary_key=True)
    estacao_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("estacao.id"), nullable=False)
    uf = Column(String(2), ForeignKey("municipio.uf"))
    cod = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("municipio.cod"))
    valor = Column(Numeric(10, 2))

    estacao = relationship("Estacao")
    municipio = relationship("Municipio")
    municipio = relationship("Municipio")


class Avulsa(Base):
    __tablename__ = "avulsa"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    ref = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("avulsa.id"))
    x = Column(Integer, unique=True)

    avulsa = relationship("Avulsa")
